metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: BEMNOX crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C22 H23 Ce1 Mn2 N8 O19 1+,N1 O3 1-,2(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Ce1 (Ce) has 10 O neighbors; Mn1 (Mn) has 4 O neighbors; Mn2 (Mn) has 4 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a chain with approximately linear metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 2.659-3.793 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 94.32-175.90°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [CeMn2O3(O2CMe)(NO3)4(H2O)2(bpy)2](NO3)·2H2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 4 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 2 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 1 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 4 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)), 2 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)), 1 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)). Article name explicitly identifies Mn(IV).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
